house.description: Aspirus Lake View Hospital grant funding provided for certified nursing assistant training, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to Aspirus Lake View Hospital for certified nursing assistant training.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CERTIFIED NURSE ASSISTANT TRAINING. +]

[+$42,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Aspirus Lake View Hospital, a nonprofit, to provide workforce training to create up to 12 new certified nursing assistants for local employers. Grant money may be used for training and curriculum costs, certification testing, and a retention bonus for trainees. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a grant to Aspirus Lake View Hospital for certified nursing assistant training.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CERTIFIED NURSE ASSISTANT TRAINING.

$42,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Aspirus Lake View Hospital, a nonprofit, to provide workforce training to create up to 12 new certified nursing assistants for local employers. Grant money may be used for training and curriculum costs, certification testing, and a retention bonus for trainees. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027.
